result.reason: The grant appropriately covers affiliates and contractors and permits transfer in specified M&A transactions, but it does not fully implement the duration and termination position. It labels every licence “irrevocable” without distinguishing paid-up from subscription licences, while retaining language making the licence conditional on fee payment and permitting termination otherwise under the Agreement. It therefore neither clearly makes paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable nor limits termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach. The conflicting irrevocability and termination language is also professionally unclear; a tailored distinction between paid-up and subscription licences was needed.
